verdict.rationale: Atlas documents its own controlled document workflow for one contract type: founders can create, send, and track SAFEs from the Dashboard instead of using email attachments. It also provides Cooley-developed legal templates and a Documents tab for incorporation documents. Nothing shows general contract drafting, negotiation, or redlining, so this covers only a narrow slice of the story. Missing for 10: redlining and version comparison, negotiation and counterparty review workflow, support for general commercial contracts beyond SAFEs and incorporation templates, approval controls, and hands-on corroboration.
